name: Mumbai University REV-2024 Scheme (NEP 2020)
description: Mumbai University Revised 2024 Scheme — NEP 2020 aligned, 20 marks IA + 80 marks ESE, 5 units

in_semester.name: Internal Assessment (IA)
in_semester.notes: NEP-aligned continuous assessment with multiple components throughout the semester.

instructions: Question No. 1 is compulsory (covering multiple units).
Attempt any THREE from Q.2 to Q.5 (or equivalent choice structure).
Answer Q.1 or Q.2, Q.3 or Q.4, Q.5 or Q.6, Q.7 or Q.8, Q.9 or Q.10.
Neat diagrams must be drawn wherever necessary.
Figures to the right indicate full marks.

question_structure.description: Five units, one OR-pair per unit. Total 10 questions, pick 5 (one per unit). Each question carries 16 marks with sub-questions.
